nonBlockingObservations.summary: The completed baseline is reused by exact report and suite hashes, while the superseded candidate is excluded; the final candidate has fresh source-pinned owning checks, targeted positives, and full suites.
The delayed-read control directly observes both post-read Instant samples, and separate compiled runtime mutations catch the arming-read and failed-determination-read order inversions.
Acceptance is limited to the macOS D3b-2 library unit; production composition, the real Rust3 seam, Linux and containment work, D5 qualification, and project completion remain open.
